answer: Summary of the recent BBC News story 'Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says' (published ~9 hours ago at https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ckzd9p7e4eqeo): An Israeli air strike on the Nasser hospital in Khan Younis, southern Gaza, killed six people - including medical staff, patients and surgeon Dr Rizq Abu Shaira - and injured about 30, according to the Hamas-run health ministry.
